author: root Codex personal positive mechanism design and symbolic counterexample
status: Conditional architecture design; not implemented, not a performance or first-publication claim

positive_contribution_card.problem: Stage83's full accepted-source-return destination preparation avoids a held-R/fresh-PTE cycle, but may require multiple destination translations and retained region records before any source data can start. Splitting the source at every destination permission boundary instead adds source AR and READ-side work.
positive_contribution_card.new_rule: Before accepting an ordered source AR of N words, a continuously prepared and retained destination WRITE prefix covers C words. Permit the unsplit AR when its complete unprepared suffix U=N-C fits Q actual exclusive return slots. Do not physically claim any AW beyond the prepared prefix. Stream the authorized prefix, then retain the remaining U source words while preparing the next WRITE region. Q refers to counted actual safe capacity, not nominal FIFO depth or speculative future freed space.
positive_contribution_card.added_capability: An already accepted long source read can complete its RLAST before the final destination page translation is ready, without adding payload memory, source reread, a second source AR or unauthorized W. Full destination preparation before source AR is sufficient but not necessary under this narrower invariant.
positive_contribution_card.correction_to_stage83: The blanket full-return-envelope requirement is required by the stage83 small-buffer general contract, but it has a safe alternative: reserve enough return capacity for the entire still-unprepared suffix after all prepared-prefix words can drain. This design explicitly changes that contract and proves the alternative, rather than silently using incomplete permissions.
strong_controls: Full envelope READ/WRITE pretranslation before one source AR, same payload capacity and physical child interface
Split source AR at destination WRITE boundary, count both AR/READ preparation work and any ability to interpose the next PTE
Read only a fully reserved whole buffer chunk and translate its destination on demand
Exact published MMU-aware DMA failed-burst drain/reissue, with failure/reissue semantics and all traffic recorded
positive_contribution_card.because: Ordinary split/full-buffer/full-prepare methods are concrete alternatives with different resource or dynamic costs; merely adding this same suffix rule to an imagined ordinary controller does not establish an earlier publication. Generic credit reservation, translation prefetch and retained PA are established components.
positive_contribution_card.if: If an exact implementation comparison excludes the same permission-frontier/unsplit-read capability, and its saved early preparation or AR/state cost matters under actual multi-DMA translation feedback, the conditional admission rule can form a narrow mechanism contribution. If published hardware already has this admission invariant at the same cost, reproduce its boundary and redesign that limitation.

contract: One primer AR envelope, aligned fixed-width words, ordered R for this AR; no additional unreserved AR, no interleaved unrelated stream sharing its Q slots. Other accepted returns have full independent reservation.

Destination permission is a continuous logical prefix covering every word before C. Its actual PA/operation/domain remains usable until all physical prefix writes and responses settle; next-page preparation does not block the trusted prefix data path.

The prefix can make real W progress independent of the missing tail translation. Its child AW cannot cross the prepared range. Other W owners eventually retire or use the safe bounded escape contract; WREADY and arbitration are eventually serviced.
Mapping is stable, source is stable Normal memory, no alias/overlap/atomic/MMIO. Only successful read returns are covered; fault handling requires an explicit drain/error path.

Q is guaranteed return storage after excluding other descriptors, skid/metadata-conflicting allocation and unrelated source data. A private ordered FIFO may lend its slots to prefix words before the suffix arrives because the suffix cannot overtake the prefix.
root_conditional_proof.rank_argument: If R is blocked while any authorized prefix word remains buffered, that head word has a retained WRITE path and can drain without the missing destination walk; eventual W service reduces that prefix backlog. After the final prefix word is consumed, at most U unprepared words from this source AR can ever remain or arrive. If U<=Q, every one can be accepted, including RLAST. Therefore this source AR cannot indefinitely retain the shared return channel solely because the next destination translation is missing. A PTE queued behind its RLAST can then return.
root_conditional_proof.not_claimed: No arbitrary system deadlock proof, no uniform elapsed-time bound, no guarantee that PTW is earlier than in a split-AR control, and no fault/remap correctness from a generation counter alone. This eliminates one precisely specified dependency cycle.
root_conditional_proof.strict_boundary: If U>Q, all Q slots can contain only unprepared tail data while the next tail R holds VALID/RLAST ahead of the new PTE response. No legal W can pop those words before the missing WRITE permission. Under serial return service this is a circular wait. The U<=Q test is therefore necessary for a general guarantee under this restricted one-envelope contract, unless more capacity, a separate return escape channel, source splitting or another drain capability is supplied.
root_conditional_proof.multiple_prepared_regions: C is a continuous prefix frontier, not the count of arbitrarily translated pages. A hole inside the prefix stops the writable head; translated later pages do not reduce U until the hole is closed. Future PTE success is never borrowed as current capacity.

finite_hand_witness.units: Abstract event times; not executed model/RTL cycles
finite_hand_witness.geometry: Q3,N8,C5,U3. Source AR8 accepted before0, WRITE prefix0..4 prepared. First physical prefix child AW5 at3 with r3, so it also obeys L<=r+Q. One serialized shared R lane; next destination PTE request is behind this source AR's RLAST.
events: R words0/1/2 at0/1/2 fill3; first AW5 at3.
True prefix W0..4 at4..8. FIFO pop space is reusable by R next cycle. R3/4/5/6/7 at5/6/7/8/9; these are in source order. Words5/6/7 are the unprepared tail.
At9 the complete tail occupies exactly3 slots and source RLAST is accepted. No tail W has occurred and no tail WRITE permission is inferred.

The next-page PTE can now return over the same lane. After its actual permission result and old child B are available, issue a fully resident tail AW3, write those original three source words and merge one logical completion. No source reread/null W is needed by this witness.
finite_hand_witness.complete_work: One source AR,8 source R/true W, two destination WRITE region preparations, physical child counts determined by actual prepared boundaries; only one destination region had to be ready before source launch. Source own READ preparation is unchanged.
finite_hand_witness.opposite_boundary: Q3,N9,C5,U4: the same authorized prefix drains, but tail words5/6/7 fill3 and word8/RLAST is held. Its missing destination PTE is behind that held R, and tail words cannot be written legally. The same prefix path no longer guarantees progress.
finite_hand_witness.complete_control_limit: Fully prepared control can send one source AR but requires both region results before launch. Split control can send two source AR and may get the second PTE earlier between their returns. Neither is assumed slower; all jobs' full completion and work must be measured on equal service.

platform_geometry_witness.prospective: Aligned64-bit source N256 within one source4KiB page; destination page offset0x818 gives first253 words in its first4KiB region and tail3 words in the next page. U3 fits the small private return FIFO if no hidden occupancy consumes its capacity. Each physical WRITE child remains within its individually prepared page.
platform_geometry_witness.opposite: Destination offset0x820 gives first252 and tail4. Q3 admission must reject or require one more prepared region/source split.
platform_geometry_witness.source_check_pending: Verify actual engine independently cuts src/dst at page and configured maximum length, matching ordered source return and the actual payload/spill capacity. A nominal256-beat example is not accepted as current production geometry until critical source checks confirm it.

complete_cost.state: Source envelope length/received/true-written progress, continuous permission frontier and original destination offset, retained current prefix PA/operation/domain, actual Q ownership, next preparation origin/result and source-RLAST/physical-B lifetime. Count any new counters and port arbitration; do not assume inactive descriptor fields are free.
complete_cost.mapping_records: One retained WRITE record can be reused after its actual prefix B if the next PTE is not retained early. Overlapping next-page preparation may require a second record or hold a shared TL response and block its service. Both effects are charged. Full-prepare ordinary receives the same record budget.
complete_cost.data: Existing Q slots store prepared prefix transiently and later the entire U tail; no extra payload is claimed. Byte realignment and multiple outstanding AR can reduce effective capacity and invalidate this simple bound.
complete_cost.dynamic: Count original versus split source AR, all READ/WRITE prepares, every physical child AW/B, useful/null W, all jobs' ACK/walk stalls and command/error handling. No prediction of overall speed from one fewer startup translation or one fewer AR.

MMUaware2018.relevance: Avoids buffering missing writes by retaining bursts in source memory and dropping/reissuing failed requests. Its described DMA moves between cluster-local SPM and translated external memory, rather than proving the present coupled memory-to-memory unsplit source-return suffix invariant. Exact author RTL still needs inspection.

ArmLTI2026.relevance: Nonclaiming preparation and compatible retained-region reuse are common components, not the new prefix-versus-buffer admission predicate.

primary_scope_review.search_limit: Targeted searches found generic DMA buffer/deadlock and IOMMU virtual-channel work, but no absence/firstness conclusion is inferred. Exact primary implementation comparison remains a decision gate.

next_decision: After source geometry and pre-mux path checks, compare only U=Q and U=Q+1 plus full-prepare/split control with actual translation return coupling. Reuse prior model components; no large new matrix or production build at this design stage.
